verdict.rationale: A desktop app for visual diff review and side-by-side sessions is a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a terminal CLI, an experimental browser UI, and git-commit-based review. None of these is a desktop app with visual diffs or parallel sessions, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
